item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem: Meera's grandmother cooks porridge using jowar, bajra, ragi, and sanwa. Which statement correctly describes these grains?

options.A: They are ordinary grains with little nutritional value, so they should be replaced by rice.
options.B: They are millets, native crops of India, that are highly nutritious and rich in vitamins and minerals such as iron.
options.C: They are imported grains that are difficult to grow in India.
options.D: They are small grains that are unhealthy because of their size.
